text:
lucas: FYI onboarding sampleapp broke on a customer trial when deployed to an Edge environment. Works in local vite dev but fails during build+edge runtime. Minimal repro attached in ticket.

natalie: Can you paste the exact errors you saw?

lucas: Two places: build step prerender fails with a module export error, then the Edge runtime crashes at init.

lucas: Vite build prerender log: 
```
Uncaught SyntaxError: The requested module '/node_modules/@redwood/inference-js/dist/cjs/index.js' does not provide an export named 'createCompletion'
```

tim: That usually means the bundler resolved to a CJS file for an ESM import. Which package exports map are you hitting?

lucas: SDK version: @redwood/inference-js@2.1.0-canary.2026.03.22. Downgrading to 2.0.3 bypasses the runtime crash but then types in our app don't match.

rachel: What's the Edge runtime error?

lucas: On Vercel Edge when importing the package I see: 
```
TypeError: Cannot redefine property: exports
    at Function.defineProperty (<anonymous>)
    at Object.<anonymous> (/var/task/node_modules/@redwood/inference-js/dist/cjs/index.js:8:12)
```

natalie: That is the CJS build mutating module.exports with defineProperty shims. Edge sandboxes disallow that.

lucas: Also tsc in CI fails with: 
```
src/lib/inference.ts:9:10 - error TS2345: Argument of type 'InferenceClient' is not assignable to parameter of type 'ClientFactory'.
9 const client = new InferenceClient(cfg)
           ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
  types/index.d.ts:21:3
    21 export type ClientFactory = (opts?: any) => ClientInstance
```
So the .d.ts exports a factory type while runtime provides a class.

rachel: Short-term mitigations we used in the sampleapp templates: 
- Vite: set `ssr: { noExternal: ['@redwood/inference-js'] }` so Vite bundles ESM sources.
- Webpack/Rollup: alias '@redwood/inference-js' -> '@redwood/inference-js/dist/esm/index.js'.
- Direct import: `import { createCompletion } from '@redwood/inference-js/dist/esm/index.js'` in Edge lambdas.

lucas: I added a tiny shim in the repo at shims/redwood-esm.js with `export * from '@redwood/inference-js/dist/esm/index.js'` and aliased the package to that as a temporary fix. Works but ugly.

natalie: Please open an internal issue with the repro and link the gist. Will label P1 for packaging.

lucas: Filed infra-inference#2340 with gist and sampleapp matrix (Vite/Next/SvelteKit). @dev-bot kicked off a CI matrix to reproduce.

dev-bot: CI: infra-inference#2340 started  matrix=Vite|Rollup|Webpack node=18|20

tim: Proposed long-term fix: 1) reorder package.json exports so `import`/`module`/esm path wins for browser/edge/bundlers; 2) ensure CJS build doesn't call defineProperty on exports; 3) update .d.ts to export a class-like constructor and add TS smoke test in CI.

rachel: I'll add a docs note in onboarding with the Vite ssr snippet and the alias hack so users hit a helpful hint instead of failing.

natalie: I'll pick up the packaging PR to normalize exports and publish a patched canary, then backport to 2.0.x.

lucas: Thanks — leaving the repro in the ticket. I'll update when the patch publishes.
